id.patternErrorMessage: Use a kebab-case id: lowercase letters and digits, joined by single hyphens (disney-plus)
id.description: The provider id it gets, and its file name once added (xbox-game-pass)

name.description: Its name, as the provider writes it

website.description: Its home page, where the pipeline starts looking

category.patternErrorMessage: Use a kebab-case id: lowercase letters and digits, joined by single hyphens (disney-plus)
category.description: A service category id from categories.yaml

source.description: own: one of your own services, first in the queue. wikidata: found by npm run data:queue. manual: added by hand

wikidata.description: Its Wikidata item, when it came from there

sitelinks.description: How many Wikipedia articles it has: the queue puts the most written-about first

status.description: queued: a batch takes it next. done: it has a provider file. rejected: a person said no. unreadable: its pages couldn’t be read (a bot check, a geo-block). out-of-scope: not a personal or family subscription (business only, free, closed)

date.patternErrorMessage: Use a real date written YYYY-MM-DD

note.description: Why it was rejected, couldn’t be read or is out of scope, or anything else to know
